theme.title: Russell, Wilt and Baylor
theme.subtitle: The NBA in the 1960s
theme.recap: Boston won eight titles in a row while Wilt, Baylor and West put up numbers that look like misprints today.

questions.prompt: How many NBA titles in a row did Boston win from 1959 to 1966?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Boston Celtics won eight in a row from 1959 to 1966.

questions.prompt: Elgin Baylor set the NBA single-game scoring record on November 15, 1960. How many points did he score?
questions.note: 71, a record until Wilt passed it the next season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: On November 15 of the 1960–61 season, Baylor set an NBA scoring record when he scored 71 points in a victory

questions.prompt: In Game 1 of the 1969 Finals, how many points did Jerry West score against Boston?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He used this freedom to score 53 points on opposing guards

questions.prompt: In Game 7 of the 1962 Finals, Bill Russell set the record for rebounds in a quarter. How many?
questions.note: 19 in one quarter, the most of any NBA quarter.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Russell's 19 rebounds in a single quarter is the most of any NBA quarter

questions.prompt: In his record-setting rebounding game on November 24, 1960, how many rebounds did Wilt grab in one half?
questions.note: 31 in a single half, in a game his team lost.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Record set in a losing effort; grabbed 31 rebounds in one half; scored 34 points
